mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserLock */ USER_NUMB FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} FOR UPDATE

SELECT /* getActiveTimerDtl */ TIMER.TMRX_NUMB, TIMER.USER_NUMB, TIMER.REPT_NUMB, TIMER.TMRX_STAT, TIMER.STRT_DATE, TIMER.LAST_STRT, TIMER.ENDX_DATE, TIMER.READ_SECS, TIMER.REGI_DATE, TIMER.UPDT_DATE, BOOK.BOOK_TITL, BOOK.BOOK_CVIM FROM TM_RDTMRX TIMER LEFT JOIN TM_REPORT REPORT ON REPORT.REPT_NUMB = TIMER.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_BKINFO BOOK ON BOOK.BOOK_NUMB = REPORT.BOOK_NUMB WHERE TIMER.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND TIMER.TMRX_STAT IN (#{runningStat}, #{pausedStat}) ORDER BY TIMER.TMRX_NUMB DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: /* setTimer */ INSERT INTO TM_RDTMRX (USER_NUMB, REPT_NUMB, TMRX_STAT, STRT_DATE, LAST_STRT, READ_SECS, REGI_DATE, UPDT_DATE) VALUES (#{userNumb}, #{reptNumb}, #{tmrxStat}, #{strtDate}, #{lastStrt}, #{readSecs}, #{regiDate}, #{updtDate})

/* setReadingDaily */ INSERT INTO TB_RDATDX (USER_NUMB, READ_DATE, READ_SECS, UPDT_DATE) VALUES (#{userNumb}, #{readDate}, #{readSecs}, #{updtDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE READ_SECS = READ_SECS + VALUES(READ_SECS), UPDT_DATE = VALUES(UPDT_DATE)
